data.action: 倚栏独坐举盏温酒轻啜
data.description: 【令 · 龙门酒肆独酌】夜幕下的龙门老街酒肆二楼，蓝发如瀑的岁之龙女倚栏独坐，将一盏温酒缓缓举至唇边。龙角在墨青旗袍映衬下泛着幽光，她微微眯起蓝瞳，望着楼下川流的人群轻笑——「千年过去，人间依旧热闹。只是这酒，还是独酌最香。」
data.lighting: warm lantern glow, amber wine reflections, soft window moon
data.promptProse: Ling sits alone against the upstairs railing of a Lungmen tavern, bringing a cup of warm wine to her lips. Her long blue hair falls over her ink-teal qipao. The slightly low medium view includes carved beams overhead and passing market visitors below. Lanterns warm her cheek and the lacquered tabletop; moonlight from the window cools her horns and wine-cup edge.
data.title: 令 · 龙门酒肆独酌
